linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Tool Dejinta
linux_setup_welcome: Dejinta SP Flash Tool ee Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Soo dejinta iyo habaynta mishiinka biligleynaya xawaaraha sare si aad u soo celiso oo aad u cusboonaysiiso ciyaartoygaaga dadaal la'aan.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek qalab biligleynaya oo leh maktabad caalami ah oo la jaan qaadaya.
linux_card_usb_desc: Waxay siisaa ogolaanshaha desktop-ka si loola xiriiro ciyaaryahanka ku jira qaabka Bootloader.
system_checker_title: Hubiyaha Nidaamka Qalabka SP Flash & Baadhitaanka
system_checker_desc: Xaqiijinta dhammaystiran ee darawallada, qaybaha kernel-ka, oggolaanshaha, iyo maktabadaha runtime si loo xaqiijiyo hillaac la isku halayn karo.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Wuxuu u diyaariyaa kombayutarkaga inuu ku xidho ciyaartoygaaga wixii cusboonaysiin ah.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Waxay hubisaa habaynta sare ee Linux ee SP Flash Tool, gelitaanka USB, oggolaanshaha taxanaha ah, iyo qaybaha nidaamka.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Wuxuu u diyaariyaa kombuyuutarkaaga inuu ku xidhmo ciyaartoygaaga oo uu ku rakibo cusboonaysiinta software si la isku halleyn karo.
settings_checker_desc: Wuxuu u diyaariyaa kombuyuutarkaaga inuu ku xidhmo ciyaartoygaaga oo uu ku rakibo cusboonaysiinta software si la isku halleyn karo.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kumbuyuutarkaaga ayaa diyaar u ah inuu ku xidho ciyaartoygaaga.
linux_prep_ready: Diyaar ah, SP Flash Tool waa la diyaariyey.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Ciyaartoyga waa la helay, gelitaanka xidhiidhka soo cusboonaysiinta…
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Waxaad ku xidhi kartaa ciyaartoygaaga marka lagu weydiiyo.
linux_prep_blocked: Kumbuyuutarku ma shaqayn karo SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Furahaaga sirta ah ayaa loo baahan yahay hal mar si kombuyuutarkan loogu sameeyo biligleynaya: xeerarka USB-ga ee aaladaha MediaTek iyo marinka marinka dekedaha.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Si aad kombuyuutarkan ugu dejiso SP Flash Tool, eraygaaga sirta ah ayaa loo baahan doonaa tallaabada xigta si loo habeeyo xeerarka USB oo loogu daro akoonkaaga kooxaha adeegsadaha taxanaha ah ee loo baahan yahay. Haddii aad diido, codsigu wuu xidhmayaa.
linux_prep_needs_access: Gelitaanka lama ogolaan, biliglihi wuu u baahan yahay.
linux_prep_fixed: Helitaanka waa la oggolaaday, SP Flash Tool waa diyaar.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Dejinta waa dhammaatay oo koontadaada waxaa lagu daray kooxaha isticmaala ee loo baahan yahay SP Flash Tool. Fadlan dib u billow kombayutarkaga si ay ogolaanshaha cusub u hirgalaan,kadibna mar kale fur abka. Guji calaamadda si aad hadda u xidho abka.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: La sameeyay, xidh App-ka si aad dib ugu bilowdo Computer
settings_driver_desc: Kahor intaadan isticmaalin app-ka markii ugu horeysay, waa inaad ku rakibtaa darawalka USB MediaTek, ka dibna dib u bilow kombuyutarkaaga.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Si Toos ah u Hagaaji Oggolaanshaha & Nidaamka Dejinta
home_desc: Ka hel firmware khadka tooska ah ama dooro xirmo maxalli ah, ka dibna ku falaqsii qalabkaaga.
sel_source_desc: Soo deji firmware online, ama soo deji xirmo maxalli ah.
settings_advanced_desc: Wuxuu muujiyaa habka rakibida, qaabka rakibida iyo filtarrada sii deynta.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Abka waxa uu kula joogayaa daminta, isku xidhka, iyo rakibida
settings_sp_gui_install: Ku rakib SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Xidhaa Cusbooneysiinta CE oo furto SP Flash Tool GUI oo wata faylalka kala firdhisan ee firmware-ka la doortay iyo sawirada qaybinta horay loo raray.
settings_terminal_desc: Ku rakibida software-kaaga gudaha Terminal si aad u aragto macluumaadka farsamada ee horumarka
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Ku rakibida software-kaaga Command Prompt si aad u aragto macluumaadka farsamada ee horumarka
settings_sp_auth_desc: Ikhtiyaari Qaar ka mid ah bartilmaameedyada MediaTek waxay diidaan inay iftiimiyaan ilaa SP Flash Tool la siinayo faylka aqoonsiga (.auth); ku dar kaaga halkan haddii qalabku u baahan yahay.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Fayl kala firdhisan lagama helin xirmadan, markaa wax amar ah oo console ah lama dhisi karo.
terminal_install_no_tool: Ma jiro SP Flash Tool dhis ama barta MTKlient ee laga galo habkan.
terminal_install_failed: Waa la furi waayay daaqadda terminaalka Amarka rakibida waxaa loo qoray {path}.
status_terminal_install: Ku rakib amarka ka furmay daaqadaada terminalka ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} hadda waxay furmi doontaa orodka {method}.

• Haddii aysan horay u damin, dami {device}.
Haddii ay ku xidhan tahay USB, ka saar marka hore.
{hint}
Ku xidh qalabkaaga kombayutarka marka {terminal_name} daaqadu furmo.

Guji OK si aad u bilowdo oo aad uga baxdo Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: Talo: Haddii qalabku aanu si toos ah ugu xidhmin, si tartiib ah u riix badhanka dib u dajinta ee godka pinhole adigoo isticmaalaya xaashida marka aad isku xidhayso fiilada USB-ga.
terminal_hint_generic: Talo: Geli qalabkaaga qaabka soo dejinta firmware (ku kala duwan yihiin qaabka: tusaale ka saar batteriga oo ka fogee fiilada USB-ga ee ku xiran, ama dami adigoo batteriga ku jira, ama qabo Mugga Hoos u dhaca marka aad isku xireyso USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Ku rakib adigoo isticmaalaya SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
Qalabka SP Flash GUI wuxuu hadda ku furmi doonaa firmware-kaaga horay loo sii raray.

• Qalabka SP Flash, ka dooro "Download" sanduuqa hoos u dhaca.
• Guji badhanka "Download".
Hubi in {device} damsantay oo ay go'day.
{hint}
• Ku xidh fiilada USB kombuyuutarkaaga ka dib markaad gujiso Download.

Guji OK si aad u bilowdo SP Flash Tool oo aad uga baxdo Updater CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Marka la furo, mawduucyada Rockbox si toos ah ayaa loogu wareejiyaa Y1 ka dib markii lagu guulaysto rakibidda Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Waanu kari waynay in aanu dul saarno xidhmada mawduucyada ciyaartoygaaga. Waxaad mar kale isku dayi kartaa Settings
settings_filter_original_pre307: Muuji Software-ka Asalka ah ee la sii daayay ka weyn 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Siidaynta Software-ka asalka ah ee ka weyn 3.0.7 kuma habboona cutubyada Y1 ee lagu iibiyo Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ku iftiiminta dhismihii hore ee cutubyadan waxay ka ilaalin doontaa inay kor u qaadaan ilaa nooc cusub dib loo rakibo.

Ma hubtaa inaad doonayso inaad tusto Software-yada Asalka ah ee ka weyn 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Waxay muujisaa inay dhisto zip-ka ROM-ku uu yahay 240p nooc (rom…_240p.zip). Dhismayaasha 240p kuma habboona cutubyada Y1 ee Innioasis OS ee ka hooseeya 3.0.7, marka Show Old Rockbox Builds waa la awooday.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Siidaynta Rockbox-Y1 ka hor 0.5 kuma habboona cutubyada Y1 ee la iibiyay ka dib Maarso 2026 iyadoo la sii rakibay Innioasis OS 3.0.7.

Ku iftiiminta dhisme duug ah oo ku saabsan aaladahan waxay ka hortagaysaa bootinta.

Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad muujiso dhismayaashii Rockbox ee hore?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Fadlan dooro .zip, .rar archive, ama fayl kala firdhiso (* firdhiso*.txt) gudaha galka firmware-ka si aad ugu rakibto firmware-ka aad dooratay {target}.
sel_offline: Liisaska onlaynka ah lama heli karo hadda. Isticmaal faylka maxaliga ah, ama hubi xidhiidhkaaga.

rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_title: Xirmooyinka Firmware-ka Badan ee La Helay
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Baakado badan oo firmware ah ama faylal kala firdhiyey ayaa laga helay galkan/khadkan. Fadlan dooro gal ama kayd ka kooban hal xidhmo oo firmware ah markiiba.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Siideyntani waxay ka kooban tahay in ka badan hal fayl oo kala firdhiyey, markaa Updater ma sheegi karo qaabka uu ciyaartoygu u baahan yahay. Sameeyaha {software} wuxuu u baahan doonaa inuu cusboonaysiiyo sii dayntooda firmware si loogu daro hal fayl oo kala firdhiyey.
sp_search_restart: Qalab wali ma jiro, oo dib u raadinaya (isku day {count}). Ciyaartoyga dami ku xidh oo ku xidh marka laguu sheego.
sp_auth_missing_file: Faylka xaqiijinta lama helin ({path}); biligleynaya la'aanteed.
sp_config_missing_platform: Faylka kala firdhiso ma caddeeyo madalkeeda, markaa qaabeynta konsole ee faylka xaqiijinta lama dhisi karo; biligleynaya la'aanteed.
sp_config_missing_storage: Faylka kala firdhiso kuma dhawaaqo nooca kaydinta (EMMC/NAND/UFS), marka qaabaynta konsole ee faylka xaqiijinta lama dhisi karo; biligleynaya la'aanteed.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Fayl xaqiijin ah lama siin; bilig la'aan.
sp_config_write_failed: Ma qori karo faylka qaabeynta console-ka; biligleynaya iyada oo aan la helin faylka xaqiijinta.

settings_notifications_unavailable: Ogeysiinta nidaamka lagama heli karo kumbuyuutarkan.

settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Appka ku hay bar menu ka dib marka uu daaqadu xidhmo, si aad wali u hesho abka iyo ogaysiisyada firmware-ka ciyaartoyga. Demin: xidhidhiyaha daaqada waxa ay joojisaa abka

sel_themepack_prompt_body: Waxaad shiday dhisme 360p Rockbox ah. Ma jeceshahay inaad hadda ku rakibto Xidhmada Theme 360p qalabkan?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Ku xidh Ciyaartoyga Habka Kaydinta USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Fadlan ka saar USB, shid oo geli Rockbox hal mar (sidaa darteed waxay bilaabaysaa galka nidaamka .rockbox gudaha), ka dib dib u xidh USB oo dooro 'Habka Kaydinta USB'.

Marka lagu xiro, dhagsii Continue si aad u doorato gal kasta oo ku yaal ciyaaryahankaaga.

sel_themepack_success: Xidhmada Theme Rockbox si guul leh loogu rakibay qalabkaaga!

sel_only_local_generic: Dooro xirmo firmware maxaliga ah (.zip, .rar) ama gal ka kooban faylal kala firdhiso oo loogu talagalay rakibaadda qad la'aanta, waxay la shaqeysaa aaladaha guud ee MediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Ku rakib firmware ka faylka .zip ama .rar qalab kasta oo maqal Innioasis ah ama Timmkoo

single_instance_body: Nuqul kale ayaa furan, ama wali ka socda gadaasha. Laba koobi ayaa ku tartami doona xidhiidhka USB-ga ciyaartoyga, markaa kani ma bilaabmayo.

flash_hint_install_drivers: • Haddii aad ku jirto Windows, hubi inaad haysatid Dareewallada ku rakibay.

install_first_prerequisite_hint: Si aad u sii waddo rakibkan, fadlan xaqiiji haddii {model}gaagu uu hadda ka hor shaqaynayay software-ka saldhigga ah ee loo baahan yahay ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Waxa kaliya oo aan haysan karnaa goobahaaga iyo warbaahintaada marka ciyaartoygu uu horay u sii wado software-kan ama nooca ku haboon.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Waxa kaliya oo aanu haysan karnaa goobahaaga marka ciyaartoygu uu horeba u wado software-kan ama nooca ku haboon.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Waxa kaliya oo aan haysan karnaa goobahaaga iyo warbaahintaada marka ciyaartoygu uu horay u sii wado software-kan ama nooca ku haboon.

settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Ka booddaa su'aasha waafaqid Kaliya isticmaal tan marka aad hubiso in ciyaartoygu uu sii wadi doono la shaqayntiisa goobaha iyo warbaahinta hadda.
err_keep_data_failed: Ma hayn karo goobahaaga iyo warbaahinta: gal firmware-ka lama qori karo. Waxba lama rakibin
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Waxay ku ilaalisaa habayntaada iyo warbaahinta ciyaartoyga. Software-ka intiisa kale waxa lagu rakibay sidii caadiga ahayd.
flash_keep_data_warning: Haddii aad sii waddo tan la'aanteed, dejimahaaga iyo warbaahinta ayaa dib u dajin doona kaydinta gudaha ee ciyaartoyga.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Haddii aad ku sii waddo tan la'aanteed, mawduucyada Rockbox, fonts iyo settings waa laga saari doonaa. Muusigaaga iyo warbaahinta kale waxay sii saarnaan doonaan ciyaaryahanka.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Haddii aad sii waddo tan la'aanteed, mawduucyada Rockbox, xarfaha iyo dejinta waa laga saari doonaa, kaydinta gudaha ee ciyaartoyga ayaa dib loo dajin doonaa.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Haddii aad sii waddo tan la'aanteed, dejimahaaga dib ayaa loo dajin doonaa. Muusigaaga iyo warbaahinta kale waxay sii saarnaan doonaan ciyaaryahanka.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Firmware-kani waa inuu dib u habeeyaa kaydinta gudaha ee ciyaartoyga. Dejinta kaydsan waa la tirtiri doonaa; Muusigaaga iyo warbaahinta kale ayaa meesha joogi doona.
format_all_data_warning_other: Firmware-kani waa inuu dib u habeeyaa kaydinta gudaha ee ciyaartoyga. Dejinta la kaydiyay iyo warbaahinta lagu kaydiyay kaydinta ku dhex jirta waa la tirtiri doonaa. Warbahinta ku jirta microSD-gaaga ayaa ku sii jiri doonta meesheeda.
format_all_confirm_body:
Wixii {software} Waxaan u baahanahay inaan dib u habeyn ku sameyno {model} kaydintaada gudaha ka hor inta aanan sii wadin. Kadibna qalab kale oo SP Flash ah ayaa la isku dayi doonaa, laakiin qaabka loo qaabeeyey + qaabka loo soo dejiyo iyada oo loo marayo habka XML console-mode.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Ka saar USB-ga, ka dibna geli xaashida ama pinhole-ka dib-u-dejinta ee {model}. Guji Xiga si aad mar kale isugu daydo Qaabka All + Download mode.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool ayaa sheegay in miiska qaybinta ciyaaryahanku isbedelay (8502). Firmware-kan waa in lagu rakibaa Qaabka All + Download mode, kaas oo wax ka beddelaya kaydinta gudaha.
install_first_hint: Kahor intaadan dejin {target} markii ugu horeysay, {model}kaaga wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu socdo {software} — ama {target} lafteeda, haddii hore loo rakibay oo shaqaynayo.
install_first_power_on_fmt: Fadlan ka saar USB-ga, korantada {model} oo guji Next.
install_first_power_on_hint: Ciyaartoyga hal mar ku bilaabo firmware-ka saldhiga, ka dibna dami rakibida soo socota.

support_story_1_body: Innioasis wuxuu si joogto ah u soo saaraa qalabyada cusub ee ciyaartoyda sida Y1 (oo lagu beegsanayo dib u eegisyada guddiga qarsoon sida 6.0, 7.0, iyo 8.0) kuwaas oo si aamusnaan ah u jebiya aaladaha hore. Waxaa ka sii daran, shabakadooda waxay ku siinaysaa eber digniino iyo gelitaanka eber firmware-yadii hore ee shaqaynayey si ay uga soo kabtaan xaalad leben ah. Updater CE iyo mashruuca Firmware Community Firmware ayaa soo qaadaya qaybaha: waxaanu kaydinaynaa kayd kasta oo dhaxalgal ah ROM, si toos ah ayaanu u xaqiijinaa dib u eegista qalabkaaga, waxaanu ku ilaalinaa ciyaartoygaagu inuu si badbaado leh u socdo.

Waxaan dhisnay shabakad la isku halayn karo, madax-bannaan oo soo dejineed leh oo la xaqiijiyay SHA-256 daacadnimada, ogeysiisyada cusboonaysiinta, iyo rakibo tallaabo-tallaabo ah la hago. support_story_2_item_2: Cusbooneysii Ogeysiisyada: Digniin u hel daqiiqadda ay bulshada cusub soo dayneyso ama ay hagaajineyso

support_story_3_headline: Furitaanka awoodda buuxda ee ciyaartoygaaga Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Keenida Rockbox, nidaamyada hawlgalka fudud ee caadiga ah, iyo xoriyada maqalka
support_story_3_body: Software-ka warshadaynta kaydka ayaa kaliya xoqaya dusha waxa qalabkaaga Y1 ama Y2 uu samayn karo. Bulshadeenu waxay keentay Rockbox, nidaamyada hawlgalka caadiga ah ee fudud, dib u ciyaarida codec maqalka ah, iyo mawduucyada caadada u ah nolosha. Waxaan jeebka ka soo iibsanaa kala duwanaanshiyaha qalabka jirka si aan u tijaabino, u rogno injineerka, oo aan u xaqiijino rakibid kasta. Taageerida Cusboonaysiinta CE waxay si toos ah u maalgelisaa unugyada tijaabada waxayna dardar gelisaa horumarinta firmware-ka caadiga ah.
support_story_3_item_1: Hal-guji Rockbox: Dib-u-ciyaarista maqalka iyo mawduucyada gaarka ah ee lagu rakibay ilbidhiqsiyo gudahood.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Community: Kobcinta baytariyada, UI nadiif ah, iyo taageerada codec maqalka casriga ah.
support_story_3_item_3: Shaybaarka Hardware Firfircoon: Waxaan ku tijaabinnaa aaladaha dhabta ah ee dhabta ah ka hor inta aanan sii deyn wax dhismo ah.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% bilaash ah, software-ka ugu horreeya ee sirta ah oo aan lahayn xayeysiis ama dabagal.
support_story_4_headline: Naga caawi inaan samayno waxa Innioasis aanu samayn.
support_story_4_lead: Badbaadinta firmware-ka ay bulshadu ku shaqeyso waxay ka ilaalinaysaa aaladahaaga meelaha qashinka lagu daadiyo.
support_story_4_body: Marka shirkad qalabaysan ay u guurto qalabkooda xiga, moodooyinka da'da ah waa laga tagayaa. Innioasis ma bixiso taageero Linux, ma jiro isbeddelo hufan, iyo ma jirto hab sahlan oo lagu soo kabsado marka rakibiddu guuldareysto. Cusbooneysiinta CE ayaa jirta sababtoo ah isticmaalayaasha xiisaha leh waa inaysan iska tuurin cayaartoyga muusigga ugu fiican. 100% wax ku biirinta bulshada waxay toos u aadaan in qalabkani u furnaado qof walba.
support_story_4_item_1: Samatabbixinta & Kabitaanka: Soo kabashada la xaqiijiyay ayaa socota xitaa marka aaladaha ay diidaan in ay booteeyaan.
support_story_4_item_2: Taageerada Fasalka Koowaad ee Linux: MediaTek oo si buuxda loo taageeray oo ku iftiimaya Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Beddelka Daahfurnaanta: Qoraallada sii daynta oo faahfaahsan si aad u ogaato sida saxda ah waxa isbeddelaya.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Bulshadu Maalgeliso: Kafee kasta waxa uu xafidaa kaydka mid furan oo bilaasha dhammaan.
support_methods_subtitle: Dooro habka wax ku biirinta ee aad door bidayso. Deeq kasta waxay si toos ah u maalgelisaa soo dejinta, martigelinta, iyo qalabka tijaabinta.

err_missing_package_files_desc: Xirmada firmware-ka ayaa ka maqan faylka kala firdhisan ama faylalka sawirka loo baahan yahay. Fadlan dib u soo deji xirmada ama dooro faylka firmware oo dhamaystiran.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Faylka xaqiijinta ee aad dooratay wuu maqan yahay, madhan ama lama qori karo. Dooro fayl sax ah, ama ku nadiifi Settings, ka dibna dib u iftiimi.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Qalabka biligleynaya ama darawallada nidaamka loo baahan yahay lama bilaabi karo. Fadlan hubi ogolaanshaha nidaamka, habaynta darawalka, ama dib u rakib codsiga.
err_driver_missing_title: MediaTek USB Driver ayaa loo baahan yahay
err_driver_missing_desc: Ciladani waxay dhici kartaa marka aan la rakibin darawalka USB MediaTek. Guji Soo Dajinta Darawalada si aad u rakibto dareewalka USB MediaTek, dib u bilaabo kombayutarka, oo isku day mar kale.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Faylka firmware-ka la kaydiyay ayaa maqan. Dooro Xulo Software si aad dib ugu dhisto faylalka la soo saaray ama u soo dejiso kaydka firmware mar kale. Tani waa dhibaato faylal maxalli ah, maaha arrin ku xidhidh USB ah.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Ku noqo Xulo Software si aad dib ugu dhisto ama aad u soo dejiso xirmada firmware-ka.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Dooro siidaynta firmware si aad mar kale u soo dejiso.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Khalad lama filaan ah ayaa dhacay markii la rakibay ({detail}). Dami ciyaartoyga gabi ahaan, dib u xidh markii lagu soo jeediyo, oo isku day mar kale.
flash_method_confirm: Habka rakibaadda ayaa loo beddelay {method}. Xaqiiji in ciyaaryahanku furaha ka baxay oo damsan yahay, ka bacdi guji Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} ma bilaabin rakibidda Ka dib marka ciyaaryahanka la damiyo oo la furo, {other} waa la isticmaali doonaa bedelkeeda.
themepack_card_desc: Waxaa ku jira mawduucyo bulsho oo qurux badan, dib u eegis xallin sare leh, iyo farta loo sameeyay si gaar ah bandhigyada 360p.
themepack_installed_success: Xirmada mawduuca 360p ayaa si guul leh loo rakibay!
themepack_step1_title: Tallaabada 1: Ku xidh Habka Kaydinta USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Daar ciyaartoygaaga adiga oo haysta badhanka awoodda.
2. Marka Rockbox kabo, ku xidh fiilada USB kombiyuutarkaaga.
3. Haddii lagu soo jeediyo shaashadda ciyaartoyga, xaqiiji habka Kaydinta USB-ga si uu qalabku u muuqdo darawal ahaan.
themepack_step2_title: Talaabada 2: Dooro Folder kasta oo ku yaala Ciyaartoyga
themepack_step2_desc: Sababtoo ah nidaamyada hawlgalka (sida macOS) waxay qariyaan dotfiles (sida .rockbox) asal ahaan, waxaad dooran kartaa galka kasta ama xididka darawalka ee ciyaartoygaaga. Waxaan si toos ah kuugu heli doonaa ama kuu abuuri doonaa hagaha .rockbox.
themepack_complete: Xidhmada mawduuca si guul leh loo rakibay! Hadda waxaad si badbaado leh u goyn kartaa cayaartoygaaga oo waxaad ka dooran kartaa mawduuc ku jira Rockbox (Settings> theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: Lama heli karo ama lama bilaabi karo hagaha .rockbox ee darawalka la doortay. Fadlan hubi inaad dooratay gal ciyaartoygaaga.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Talaabada 1: Dib u bilaw ciyaartoyga oo dib isugu xidh
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Ka saar fiilada USB-ga.
2. Ku soo celi cayaartoyga oo u oggolow inuu gudaha u galo Rockbox.
3. Marka Rockbox uu socdo, dib u xidh fiilada USB, ka dibna tabo Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Tallaabada 2: Raadinta ciyaaryahanka ka sarreeya ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Appku waxa uu daawanayaa xidhiidhka ADB (ilaa 30 ilbiriqsi). Haddii qalab la helo, mawduucyada waa la wareejiyaa oo ciyaaryahanku si toos ah ayuu dib u bilaabay. Haddii kale, horay ugu gudub Habka Kaydinta USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Ma jiro qalab ADB lagu arkay 30 ilbiriqsi gudahood; Ku sii socoshada Habka Kaydinta USB
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Ma jiro binary ADB diyaar u ah abka; Ku sii socoshada Habka Kaydinta USB
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ku riixida mawduucyada iyo xarfaha ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Wareejinta ADB waa fashilantay; Dib ugu dhacaya Habka Kaydinta USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Ku rakib adigoo isticmaalaya Habka Kaydinta USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. U sahli habka kaydinta USB-ga ee ciyaaryahanka si uu ugu muuqdo darawal ahaan.
2. Dooro gal kasta oo ku yaal ciyaaryahanka hoose (.rockbox, Music, Themes, ama rootida, gal .rockbox ah oo qarsoon ayaa si toos ah u yaal).
3. Appku waxa uu ku daraa mawduucyada 360p iyo xarfaha, isaga oo dib u qoraya faylal isku magac ah.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Hadda waxaad si badbaado leh uga jari kartaa cayaartoyga oo waxaad ka dooran kartaa mawduuc gudaha Rockbox (Settings> theme Settings).
rockbox_cleanup_step: Meesha laga saarayo dejintii hore ee Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Software-kaaga cusub waa la rakibay, laakiin galkii hore ee .rockbox waa la saari waayay. Gacanta ku tirtir galka .rockbox-ka ee ciyaartoyga haddii aad rabto bilow nadiif ah.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: In ka badan hal ciyaaryahan ayaa ku xiran. Ka saar kuwa kale oo ka tag oo kaliya kan lagu rakibay.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Ciyaartoyga la ogaaday Dhigista mawduucyada bulshada & xarfaha...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Qabo badhanka dhexe si aad awood ugu yeelato Y1 kaaga, dib ugu xidh USB, oo dooro Habka Kaydinta USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Qabo badhanka korantada si aad ugu damiso ciyaartoygaaga, dib ugu xidho USB, oo dooro Habka Kaydinta USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Qalabku ma bilaabayo? Soo celi software-kii asalka ahaa
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Fadlan kala saar oo daar {model}kaaga, dabadeed taabo Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Ka saar USB-ga, qabo {button} si aad ugu damiso {model}kaaga, dabadeed taabo Next.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Fadlan awood habka kaydinta USB ee qalabkaaga oo guji Next
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Fadlan awood u geli qaabka kaydinta USB-ga {model}kaaga, ka dib dooro wadeeyaha soo muuqda
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Fadlan dooro ciyaaryahanka laftiisa ama mid ka mid ah faylalka ku yaal
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Ka saar USB-ga iyo awooda Y1 kaaga, ka dibna taabo Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Ka saar USB-ga iyo korontadaada {model}, dabadeed taabo Next.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Dooro 'Habka Kaydinta USB' ee ciyaaryahankaaga.
2. Guji 'Baro Folder...' si aad u dooratid cayaaryahankaaga oo aad u rakibto mawduucyada.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Dhismahan Rockbox wuxuu isticmaalaa 240×320 mawduucyo, kuwaas oo aan la xidhin. U hel mawduucyo bilaash ah ciyaartoygaaga goobta mawduuca Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Haddii {model}gu aanu bootin, ka saar USB-ga, qabo badhanka korantada ilaa 10s si uu dib ugu bilaabo, oo uu shid. Ama soo celi software asalka ah.
err_storage_full_title: Meel disk ah oo aan ku filnayn
err_storage_full_desc: Kumbuyuutarkaaga waxa ka dhamaaday meel wax lagu kaydiyo Fadlan ku xoree booska diskka ee darawalkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
err_usb_lost_subtitle: Ma jeclaan lahayd inaad mar kale isku daydo?
legacy_cleanup_desc: Nooc duug ah oo Updater ah ayaa weli ku jira kumbuyuutarkan oo qaadanaya meel disk ah. Dejinta waxa ay xoraynaysaa booskaas.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Soo ceshanaya ku dhawaad ​​{size} boos disk
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Ka saar arjiga hore ee Innioasis Updater iyo galka taageerada
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Ku hay Android Platform Tools (ADB / Fastboot) rakibay
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Haddii aadan isticmaalin ADB ama Fastboot meel ka baxsan Cusbooneysiinta CE, ka saar si aad u uninstall uga dhigto oo aad u soo ceshato kayd dheeraad ah.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Si guul leh loo nadiifiyey rakibaadda dhaxalka ah iyo dib u soo ceshada booska diskka.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Nooc duug ah oo Updater ah ayaa weli ku jira kumbuyuutarkan. Dejinta waxa ay xoraynaysaa meel diskka.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Tani waxay gabi ahaanba meesha ka saaraysaa abka hore, firmware-ka la soo dejiyay, iyo faylalka hadhaaga ah.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Ka saar qalabka Android Platform (ADB / Fastboot) sidoo kale? Dooro Keep haddii aad isticmaasho ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Muuji feyl galeedka gudaha Finder / Explorer
log_btn_save_file_tip: U dhoofi faylka log ee muuqda diskka
log_btn_copy_tip: Ku koobbi logu soo bandhigay sabuuraddii
